ai_summary: AIROLAM LIMITED successfully held its 19th Annual General Meeting on September 28, 2026, where all four resolutions, including the adoption of the FY2026 financial statements, were passed unanimously by the participating shareholders. This signifies shareholder approval of the company's financial reporting and key agenda items, despite varied participation levels between promoter (86.15%) and public non-institutional (36.46%) voters. A notable red flag is the significant clerical error in the document, which inconsistently lists the AGM date as "28-09-2025" in one section while confirming "28th September, 2026" elsewhere.
